data.text:
Azizi Developments has once again set a new benchmark in luxury living with the launch of Azizi Wasel, an extraordinary addition to Dubai’s real estate landscape. Nestled on the picturesque Dubai Islands, this ground breaking project promises a harmonious blend of coastal serenity and urban sophistication, offering an unmatched lifestyle experience. 

With its stunning sea views, iconic skyline as a backdrop, and a plethora of world-class amenities, Azizi Developments’ new project is all about opulence and we’re here to tell you all about it.

A Visionary Addition to Dubai Islands Real Estate

Azizi Developments unveils Azizi Wasel, a vibrant community designed to elevate the standard of living on Dubai Islands. This architectural marvel redefines luxury with its array of residences, ranging from chic studios and spacious one-bedroom apartments to lavish three-bedroom units and panoramic penthouses. Complementing the stunning homes is an array of exceptional amenities, including a cinema, swimming pools, a clubhouse, a fully-equipped gym, and premium retail spaces.

Strategically located, Azizi Wasel Dubai Islands offers unparalleled connectivity to Dubai’s key landmarks. With effortless access to Dubai International Airport, Sheikh Zayed Road, Port Rashid, and notable attractions such as the Waterfront Market, Dubai Frame, and City Centre Deira, the project ensures convenience is never compromised.

Azizi Wasel Features

The thoughtfully designed residences are a testament to modern architecture and elegance, providing panoramic views of the shimmering Arabian Gulf and the vibrant cityscape.

The development also features a comprehensive range of amenities that cater to every aspect of a resident’s lifestyle. From children’s play areas and ample parking spaces to 24/7 security and premium retail outlets, Azizi Wasel Dubai Islands is crafted to meet the needs of discerning buyers.

data.text:
Why Choose Azizi Wasel?

The project is not just about luxurious homes; it’s about creating an exceptional lifestyle. With prices starting at $272,000 (AED 1,000,000) and a flexible 50/50 payment plan, Azizi Developments’ new project offers an incredible opportunity to own a piece of the coveted Dubai Islands real estate.

As part of Dubai’s coastline enhancement initiative, Azizi Wasel Dubai Islands symbolizes a perfect blend of coastal tranquility and urban vibrancy. The development is poised to become a landmark, reflecting Azizi Developments’ commitment to excellence and innovation in real estate.

Azizi Developments’ Legacy

Azizi Developments has firmly established itself as a pillar of excellence in Dubai’s flourishing real estate market, with a proven track record of delivering more than 30,000 high-quality homes to a diverse client base spanning over 100 nationalities. The company has earned acclaim for its modern, luxury-focused projects situated in Dubai’s most prominent residential and commercial hubs. 

With an emphasis on construction excellence, transparency, and customer-first values, Azizi creates spaces that cater to various lifestyles while ensuring long-term value for both investors and residents. Beyond building properties, the developer is dedicated to shaping vibrant communities and fostering enriched lifestyles that align with the dynamic evolution of Dubai’s real estate landscape.

Currently managing a robust development pipeline of 40,000 units worth billions of dollars, Azizi plans to complete these projects by 2027. Known for its visionary contributions, the developer is behind iconic landmarks such as the world’s second-tallest skyscraper and a grand AED 2.5 billion opera house, both part of the cultural district in Azizi Venice. 

Supported by a strong land portfolio and strategic collaborations with leading master developers, Azizi plays a pivotal role in creating world-class properties in key locations, including MBR City, Palm Jumeirah, Sheikh Zayed Road, Dubai Healthcare City, and Dubai South. This enduring legacy reflects Azizi’s commitment to driving innovation and delivering excellence across Dubai’s real estate sector.
